description: This file defines an Android Activity implementing custom property animations with a custom evaluator for interpolating between XY positions, a View for drawing animated balls, and related classes for managing shape and animation states.

classes.name: CustomEvaluator
classes.description: Android Activity that demonstrates custom property animation with a custom evaluator and animated drawing of circles.

classes.name: XYHolder
classes.description: A simple holder class for X and Y float coordinates, used for animation interpolation.

classes.name: XYEvaluator
classes.description: Implements TypeEvaluator to interpolate between XYHolder instances.

classes.name: BallXYHolder
classes.description: Wraps ShapeHolder to set and get XY positions for animation.

classes.name: MyAnimationView
classes.description: Custom View that manages animated ShapeHolder objects and draws a moving ball based on the animation state.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Android Activity lifecycle method, sets up the layout, initializes the animation view, and start button.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Performs interpolation between start and end XY positions based on animation fraction.

methods.name: setXY
methods.description: Sets the XY position of the wrapped ShapeHolder.

methods.name: getXY
methods.description: Gets the current XY position as a new XYHolder.

methods.name: createBall
methods.description: Creates a drawable ball shape with random color gradient.

methods.name: startAnimation
methods.description: Starts the custom animation if not already running.

methods.name: createAnimation
methods.description: Creates the ObjectAnimator with custom evaluator to animate the ball.

methods.name: onAnimationUpdate
methods.description: Invalidates the view on each animation update to trigger redraw.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the ball at its current position.
